01-label-quality.md.title: 01 — Label quality
01-label-quality.md.question: Does the structured label model beat unstructured weak supervision?
01-label-quality.md.headline: IoU 0.978 ± 0.007 vs. 0.723 ± 0.006 (majority) and 0.761 ± 0.007 (independent); LF accuracies recovered within 0.08

02-map-benchmark.md.title: 02 — MAP benchmark
02-map-benchmark.md.question: How well do solvers find ground states?
02-map-benchmark.md.headline: Graph cut exact on ferromagnetic problems and refuses frustrated ones; SA / Ocean stand-in reach the exact optimum on n = 16; QAOA p ≤ 2 has a lower hit rate

03-sampling-benchmark.md.title: 03 — Sampling benchmark
03-sampling-benchmark.md.question: How close are samplers to Boltzmann at β = 1?
03-sampling-benchmark.md.headline: Nominal TV: Gibbs 0.01, raw annealing 0.12, calibrated 0.01, QAOA+polish 0.09 (exact-sampler floor 0.01); under strong coupling Gibbs fails, annealing does not

04-theory-checks.md.title: 04 — Theory checks
04-theory-checks.md.question: Do the paper's quantitative claims hold numerically?
04-theory-checks.md.headline: Proposition 6 bias, Proposition 8 sample complexity and Proposition 9 consistency all match

05-qpu-readiness.md.title: 05 — QPU readiness (mock)
05-qpu-readiness.md.question: Is the D-Wave path ready for real hardware?
05-qpu-readiness.md.headline: Full path runs on mock Pegasus P16; ≥ 64 (all tested) 4×4 problems per submission; exact optimum on 8/8 problems; calibration recovers β_eff ≈ 4.0 (true 4)

06-learn-beta-b.md.title: 06 — Learning β and b
06-learn-beta-b.md.question: Are β and b identifiable from votes alone?
06-learn-beta-b.md.headline: β recovered at all coupling strengths; b well identified only below the critical point (spontaneous magnetization above it)

07-class-conditional.md.title: 07 — Class-conditional LFs
07-class-conditional.md.question: Are asymmetric LF accuracies/coverages learnable?
07-class-conditional.md.headline: Identifiable (exact recovery with exact moments); in the coupled finite-data case ζ is recovered well, ω partially; IoU similar to the symmetric model

08-petlike-pipeline.md.title: 08 — Pet-format pipeline
08-petlike-pipeline.md.question: Does the real-image pipeline work end to end?
08-petlike-pipeline.md.headline: On generated Pet-layout data: structured IoU 0.787 vs. 0.671 (independent), 0.508 (majority), oracle 0.928; useless LFs get near-zero weight. Not real Pet data

09-downstream-unet.md.title: 09 — Downstream U-Net
09-downstream-unet.md.question: Do better weak labels give a better segmentation network?
09-downstream-unet.md.headline: Training-label IoU 0.80 (structured) vs. 0.68 / 0.51; U-Net test IoU 0.75 / 0.75 / 0.39 (GT-trained 0.73): network-limited on this small synthetic set

10-qpbo.md.title: 10 — QPBO
10-qpbo.md.question: How much of a frustrated posterior is decided exactly by roof duality?
10-qpbo.md.headline: Realistic posteriors: 100% labeled (MAP solved exactly by max-flow); weak LFs at θᴾ = 2: 60%; field-free spin glass: 0%; persistency verified in every case

11-multiclass.md.title: 11 — Multi-class
11-multiclass.md.question: Does the K-class model work, and what does one-hot encoding cost?
11-multiclass.md.headline: Accuracy 0.927 (structured) vs. 0.708 (independent) / 0.718 (majority); one-hot QUBO needs more reads (17/20 → 20/20 optima with 20 → 100 reads)

12-gully.md.title: 12 — Ephemeral gullies
12-gully.md.question: Can weak LFs + location labels segment EGs and detect EG locations?
12-gully.md.headline: Test location AUC 0.825 (structured largest component) vs. 0.825 (independent) / 0.723 (majority) / 0.684 (terrain alone); model chosen by grouped CV on dev; no pixel GT yet

13-pet-pipeline.md.title: 13 — Real Oxford-IIIT Pet
13-pet-pipeline.md.question: Does the structured label model help on real photographs?
13-pet-pipeline.md.headline: 200 images × 3 seeds: structured IoU 0.616 vs. 0.576 (independent), 0.494 (majority); superpixel oracle 0.963

14-pet-downstream.md.title: 14 — Downstream U-Net on real Pet
14-pet-downstream.md.question: Do better weak labels give a better network on real images?
14-pet-downstream.md.headline: Training-label IoU 0.63 (structured) vs. 0.58 / 0.50; U-Net test IoU 0.62 / 0.62 / 0.49 (GT-trained 0.74)
